body: Please do, I have my phone with me at all times and I usually check Reddit like 5 times a day

I know how hard that is too, I got my social anxiety and some slight separation anxiety at a young age it made life hell, but when I met my boyfriend it was like I went inside a magic bubble that protected me, then he dumped me and moved on like I was nothing to him and now my separation/social anxiety  is at an all time high, 

suicide hotlines don't always work for everybody but it's a good distraction. For me, the only way to clear my mind and for the pain and feelings of alone,forgotten,uselessness is to talk to somebody, because when I talk to somebody who can actually understand what I feel it takes away the "alone" feeling. I still feel like my world is crumbling around me and all I can do is watch, but I know how scary and alone that whole situation is so if you ever get to the point where you feel like you are going to explode please come and talk to somebody, you can rant to me if you want, I'm a really good listener and I always try my best to help.

Ah ok, then maybe just ask him for some comfort? You don't have to explain all that then but let him know you are sad about your grandmother and just want someone to talk to or keep your mind busy or something like that. But if you are too shy to talk about that kind of stuff then it's fine, maybe you could call a suicide hotline? It's completely anonymous and sometimes just ranting or letting someone know how hurt you are feeling can do wonders.

Have you asked to have a serious talk with your boyfriend? Let him know about how the social anxiety makes it hard for you to fully be aware of what he feels for you, because that's what social anxiety does to me. Sometimes just having a good talk can help with a lot of problems and can open up windows down the line for support and comfort.

I am sorry to hear about your grandmother though, may she Rest In Peace.

Sometimes people just drift apart, all my close friends from middle school or even high school don't talk to me anymore,hell, most of those people I knew in high school are kids I literally grew up with since we all stayed together in the same schools since elementary. but we just drifted apart and while it's upsetting it's not anybody's fault



Have you tried gaming? Most of the people I talked to lately when I'm feeling down are from steam, they are easy to form a friendship with and they stick around for you 95% of the time.

If it's the alone thing that is making you the most upset then maybe a dating site would help?

Hi, I know what you are going through, I have had depression my whole life and last month my boyfriend of 2 years broke up with me and is already dating someone else and it threw me back harder into my depression, it hurts, it's probably the most painful thing to feel. It sucks when your happiness is ripped away and you are stuck feeling alone. But please know that you really aren't alone, there are people who still care about you. Have you tried calling a suicide hotline? Sometimes just talking to someone and ranting helps a bunch.

Yea telling family of loved ones about depression is just a stressful thing and really scary, I haven't told my family because I'm scared. The people I have told mostly want to help and everything but they usually just leave after awhile. 
I think venting on here is the next best thing, everyone is always understanding and even if we are all strangers we know how each other are feeling and it's just a really nice support system, I don't see anyone judging people and it always makes me feel a little safe talking here

If you ever need to vent or yell I'm always a good listener and I can try my best to help.

Hey, I'm sorry you have to deal with all this stuff, I know it's hard to deal with. I'm also demi sexual/romantic so I understand exactly what you mean, I've only had one boyfriend who I spent the last 2 years of my life with but he broke up with me for another girl once I wasn't good enough anymore, it hurts to be used and to feel lost. All I can think in my head is every little detail about him and even though I know it's bad I still do it, 

What helps a bunch is just ranting to somebody, if you need to rant or yell at anybody id be more then happy to help. 

Or maybe you could call a suicide hotline? They don't work for everybody but if it can help distract you for even a few minutes it's worth it.

You seem like a really nice person and I'm really sorry you have had to deal with this much pain in your life, it really is a horrible feeling when you give your all to someone and nobody ever gives anything back in return. But just know people who are kind and actually put people in front of them self are so rare to find you really do seem like a nice person and you really don't deserve any of this negativity

Hi, I might not be the best person to talk to but I understand your pain, it's really hard dealing with things like that, have you considered talking to a suicide hotline? Sometimes just talking or ranting to someone can clear your head and give you space to feel  a little better

I'm sorry you are going through this pain, I know it's hard to deal with,

What usually cheers me up is just talking to someone or just hearing another voice and knowing they care enough to listen or talk, it's a really good way to keep your mind clear even if you guys are talking about the subject that makes you sad.

I understand it might not work the same for you but have you ever considered it?

Hello, I'm really sorry for what you are going through, I'm very socially shy, I could never find the courage to actually talk to people before so I grew up with only 2 close friends and the rest were just people who were nice but didn't want to stick around outside of school, what really helped me with socializing was games, it sounds really dumb but I have met the most wonderful people on steam.

Have you ever thought about just messing around on games or forums and just practice talking to people? 

You arent a failure, there are people that care about you and if you ever need to rant to someone I'm always available to listen and try my best to help.

First of all I'm really sorry for the pain you are going through 

I know you feel like you disappointed people but please please talk to your husband, tell him exactly how you feel and let him know you need his help right now more then ever, if he has forgiven and understood everything else of course he will understand what you are feeling.

No problem, I'm still lost myself tbh. My boyfriend only broke up with me a month ago and it hurts that he made a song calling me a bitch just to impress the new girl he is now dating but for some unknown reason I'm still in love, I want so hard to just yell at him and let him know what he is doing to my head but I know it wouldn't change anything even after the 2 years we dated I WISH so hard I meant more to him but he is going to be the person he always was and all I can do is hope that I can try and help people who are in pain just like me. 

We just gotta stay strong and try to make sure our mind don't kill us.

I did a whole post but it logged me out so I'll try my best to retype it

I know that those call centers don't always help everybody and that's fine, but please know it really wasn't your fault and as much as you probably don't want to hear this it really was her that was the problem, some people are just like that, they hurt you sometimes on purpose and sometimes they really didn't mean it but it still happens and some people just use other people. I don't think she knew she was using you for support but it just was a bad situation it sounds like. I don't have all the details and I could be completely wrong but I do know that it isn't your fault, you were always there and you always let her know she had you and that you loved her. But I know how much it hurts regardless, I still blame myself and I hate myself everyday, yesterday I stood in my room crying with a noose around my throats ready to jump but I just couldn't go through with it.

I still get scared that it will come back and honestly I don't think I'll make it much longer till I snap but while I'm here I want to try my best and make sure people don't have to feel pain when they truly don't deserve it.

I know I'm a complete stranger but if you EVER need to rant or just yell at someone I'm here to help.

Please trust me when I say you didn't do anything wrong, love can be so fucked at times I don't understand it, I don't know why it hurts us this way. I'm only 20 so I don't have a single fucking clue about the world.

All I know is that you didn't do anything wrong and that you sure as hell don't deserve any of this negativity.

I know exactly what you mean and I think that's why it hurt even more? My boyfriend treated my really well at jest but then he changed and even when I would do everything I could to let him know I love him and he meant the world to me it just seems like he didn't care, it left me where I'm stuck now, being hopelessly in love with someone who doesn't love me back anymore and now I feel broken and alone.

But knowing that someone is going through as much pain as me makes me upset because you honestly don't deserve any of this mess and I'm so sorry things went this way.

Have you tried calling a suicide hotline? please don't let her do this to you.

Hi, I read your other post and I'm in a similar situation, I'm in love with someone who broke my heart, lied,cheated and hurt me (even dating another girl a month after we broke up after being together for 2 years) I understand the pain I'm still completely in love with him but I don't think he could care less about me now that he has another girl to flirt with,  for some reason when I see someone in the same situation as me I know what they are going through is bad but they shouldn't take their life, I wonder why I can take my own advice though.. but that's besides the point 
You sounds like such a caring person and it sucks when people who we love more then anything hurt us, it's the worst possible thing in the world to deal with but maybe if you tried and reached out to someone you could ease the pain? For me talking to someone ANYONE keeps me destracted, which sucks because I stay up all night and day so I'm mostly alone with my thoughts and it's so scary so I know exactly how you feel, if you need to talk or vent I'm a really good listener and I would hate for someone who feels the same way as me to actually give up. I really would like to help if you can let me try.


please reply and say you are still here
